pages.title: Roadmap
pages.explainHtml:
这一页是整份讲义的目录地图。先扫一眼各节标题，建立「这节课要解决什么问题」的心理框架，再进入细节。

pages.title: 1. COMPUTE YIELDS
pages.explainHtml:
投资的 yield / IRR 是使 NPV=0 的折现率：把所有流出、流入放在时间轴上求解。

债券 YTM 就是把现价当作流出、票息与本金当作流入时的 IRR。通常需数值法（财务计算器 / Excel IRR）。

0 = −P + Σ C_t/(1+y)^t + F/(1+y)^N

pages.excerpt:
2. Various
Yield                       Coupon rate & Current yield & YTM Relationship
Measures
What is the difference between current yield and YTM?
  YTM (Yield to Maturity) = "What’s my Total Return if I hold until maturity?"

YTM includes everything (Total Return):
• The $50 annual income
• The 1,000 back at maturity → a 100 capital gain
• And the time value of money (interest on interest)

    So if you bought the bond at $900, YTM might be 6.2% (example), which is
higher than current yield because: you earn interest + You gain $100 when it
matures

pages.excerpt:
3. Yields for Portfolios & Floaters

Yield for Floaters – Part 1

For Floaters, Discount Margin (DM) is used instead of YTM (why?):
We find the discount margin in the following way:
① Assume reference rate is constant
② Try a margin (e.g., 96 bps)
③ Discount cash flows using (reference rate + margin)
④ Adjust margin iteratively until PV = price

Example: If a floater priced at par with spread 80bps, DM = 80bps

pages.title: 4. TOTAL RETURN & HORIZON
pages.explainHtml:
Horizon analysis / total return：在给定持有期、再投资利率、期末卖出收益率假设下，估算实现总回报。

YTM 假设「持有到期 + 票息按 YTM 再投资」；一旦提前卖出或再投资利率不同，实现回报会偏离 YTM。

Total future value = 再投资后的票息累积 + 期末卖出价；再换算持有期收益率

pages.excerpt:
4. Total Return and Horizon Analysis
Think of the three sources of bond return:

      Coupon interest   Capital gain/loss   Reinvestment income
                                            (interest-on-interest)
Example
3-Year Bond, Face value: $1,000, Coupon: 6% annual = $60/year,
Purchase price: $950, Held to maturity, Reinvestment rate: 5%. Then
• Coupon income = $60 *3 =180
• Interest-on-interest = 60 × 1.05 2 + 60 × 1.05 1 + 60 − 180 = 9.15
• Capital game = redeemed price–buy price = $1000-$950=$50

pages.excerpt:
4. Total Return and Horizon Analysis
Total Return

Definition:
 Total Return = Coupon income + Reinvestment of coupons + Resale Price

Total return reflects the realized return on a bond over a specific
holding period, not necessarily to maturity, factoring in:
1. Coupon income
2. Reinvestment of coupons for a given reinvestment rate (may not
    be YTM)
3. Resale price at the end of the horizon (which may differ from face
    value)

4. Total Return and Horizon Analysis
Horizon Analysis                     Horizon h

Horizon Analysis Steps: (suppose at horizon 𝒉)
① Compute total (horizon h’s) value of coupons + reinvested interest
   (FV annuity)
② Estimate the (horizon h’s) price at sale (PV of remaining cash flows)
③ Total FV (at horizon h) = step 1 + step 2
④ Solve for yield 𝑦 such that:
                 P0 1 + 𝑦 ℎ = Total FV at horizon h
⑤ Double 𝑦 to annualize if semiannual.

pages.title: 4. Total Return
pages.explainHtml:
Horizon analysis / total return：在给定持有期、再投资利率、期末卖出收益率假设下，估算实现总回报。

YTM 假设「持有到期 + 票息按 YTM 再投资」；一旦提前卖出或再投资利率不同，实现回报会偏离 YTM。

Total future value = 再投资后的票息累积 + 期末卖出价；再换算持有期收益率

pages.excerpt: 5. RETURN & RISK TRADEOFFS

pages.title: 5. Return & Risk Tradeoffs
pages.explainHtml:
常见指标：Current Yield（年票息/市价）、YTM、YTC（按赎回价与赎回日算）、Yield to Worst、现金流收益率等。

可赎回债要同时看 YTM 与 YTC；发行人会选择对自己有利的时点，投资者应关注 yield to worst。

易错点：Current yield 忽略本金损益与再投资，只能当粗指标。

• That "high first-year return" may be real in retrospect, but uncertain in

• If you knew for sure resale yield would stay low, selling early might be
  smart. But you don’t — so YTM remains the most reliable metric for long-
  term planning.

pages.title: Summary & Key Takeaways
pages.explainHtml:
总结页请当成考前速查卡：能用自己的话复述每一条，才算真懂。

对照左边要点，问自己：对应公式是什么？适用假设是什么？常见反例是什么？
pages.excerpt:
Summary & Key Takeaways

• Yield (IRR) discounts cash flows to match bond price.
• Current Yield is coupon/price; YTM includes total return.
• YTW is the worst-case yield (lowest of YTM/YTC/YTP).
• Discount bonds: YTM > Current Yield > Coupon Rate.
• Total Return combines coupons, reinvestment, and price changes.
• Horizon analysis calculates realized returns incorporating
  reinvestment rates and changing market yields.
• Short-term holders face more volatility than long-term investors.
